status: frozen before fitting any halo-scale relation
purpose: Determine which baryonic dimensions, if any, can predict the scale radius of conventional halo reconstructions across galaxies and clusters with one law. Use the answer only to select a first-principle field mechanism; NFW-derived radii are diagnostic targets, not final evidence for Sigma Gravity.

galaxy_nfw_fits.provenance: NFW V200 and concentration fitted per galaxy on inner SPARC radii with weak priors; comparator only

galaxy_baryonic_features.provenance: pre-outcome SPARC photometric, gas, and structural features

cluster_profiles.provenance: Tian et al. baryonic and GR/NFW-deprojected total acceleration profiles

cluster_metadata.provenance: Tian et al. cluster redshifts and identifiers

authorization.allowed_outcome: select a mechanism class or conclude that halo scale is not identifiable from these diagnostic products

target_construction.galaxy: r_200=V_200/[10 H_0] and r_s=r_200/c_200 using each existing per-galaxy NFW comparator fit
target_construction.cluster: Refit the published GR/NFW-derived g_tot(r) with a spherical NFW M_200,c_200 profile using the cluster redshift and Planck-like H(z); set r_s=r_200/c_200
target_construction.baryonic_mass: Galaxies use catalog stellar+gas mass. Clusters use M_b(<r_max)=g_bar(r_max)r_max^2/G after a monotonic enclosed-mass projection.
target_construction.baryonic_half_mass_radius: Galaxies solve the catalog disk+gas exponential and Hernquist-bulge cumulative proxy for 50 percent mass. Clusters interpolate the monotonic M_b(<r) profile at 50 percent of M_b(<r_max).
target_construction.claim_boundary: Neither target is theory-neutral. Galaxy r_s is prior-sensitive and cluster r_s is reconstructed from an NFW-derived profile. The audit diagnoses scaling structure only.

preregistered_relations.equation: r_s=A M_b^(1/3), equivalently one universal mean-density threshold
preregistered_relations.mechanism: Covariant refracted-gravity-like density threshold; fixed mass exponent 1/3

preregistered_relations.equation: r_s=A r_M^(1/3), equivalent to r_C=(r_M mu^-2)^(1/3)
preregistered_relations.mechanism: Published AeST cutoff; fixed mass exponent 1/6
Halo scale tracks the measured baryonic extent
Diagnostic exponent; not a selected theory

evaluation.fit_weighting: each domain receives total weight one half so 131 galaxies cannot overwhelm 20 clusters
secondary_metrics: sensitivity to non-boundary galaxy NFW fits

decision_rule: If a one-parameter fixed-exponent relation passes both RMSE and domain-bias gates, use its physical threshold as the starting scale mechanism for the next covariant action.

If the two-parameter mass-extent bridge improves equal-domain RMSE by at least 0.05 dex and removes domain bias while all mass-only laws fail, the next action must contain a continuous geometry-sensitive field invariant; it may not contain a galaxy/cluster switch.
If no relation passes, do not fit a more complicated halo-radius formula to these same NFW products. Return to raw rotation/lensing fields and treat halo radius as insufficiently identifiable.
No result from this audit authorizes holdout scoring or establishes that an NFW halo is physically real.

formula_inventory.equations: NFW r_s=r_200/c_200; MOND r_M=sqrt(GM_b/a_0); covariant refracted-gravity density scale r_rho proportional M_b^(1/3); AeST r_C=(r_M mu^-2)^(1/3); Sigma diagnostic r_s=A r_M^a R_b,50^(1-a)
